note: The pins of the three SpriteFusion command-line tools the art pipeline runs. Data, reviewed in a diff: tools/toolchain.py reads it and nothing else decides a version. A change here is a deliberate upgrade of a tool. 'sha256' lists the accepted binary hashes of this build host (macOS arm64); it is printed always and enforced only with KONCLUI_TOOLCHAIN_SHA256=enforce, because a rebuild of the same commit gives another hash. The palette-snapper hash is of a build from a LOCAL CHECKOUT of the pinned commit (cargo install from a local path, recorded in ~/.cargo/.crates2.json), not of one made by the documented 'cargo install --git ... --rev' command, which can give another hash: re-measure and list it when that command is run on the build host. 'pixel-snapper' is the FIXED build: the pinned commit plus the carried patch (patch, patchSha256; tools/patches/README.md), installed as spritefusion-pixel-snapper-fixed by tools/build_pixel_snapper.py. The patch does not change the crate version, so 'capability' is a probe that tells it from the stock tool (its --help lists --expect-cell). 'stock' keeps the pins of the stock 1.0.0 build (the Homebrew one) so that it is recognised and refused by name; nothing in ingest runs it.
